name: drecksau-online
description: Juego de cartas multijugador online 1v1 (mecanica tipo Drecksau). Nombre y arte son placeholder.

scripts.dev: npm run build -w @drecksau/engine && concurrently -n server,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @drecksau/server" "npm run dev -w @drecksau/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @drecksau/engine && npm run build -w @drecksau/server && npm run build -w @drecksau/web
